subject: Medlytics evaluation: scheduling trial window & ownership
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@medlytics.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Medlytics discovery recap + proposed trial window

Hi Laura / Samir —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the eval kickoff and technical deep dive: 

What we heard from you:
- Primary use case: extractive summarization + clinical note normalization for your care coordination workflow.
- Success signals: >90% entity recall on the prompt set, throughput of ~2000 tokens/s for bulk batch jobs, and latency <120ms P50 for single-request inference in the UI.
- Constraints: PII redaction required; procurement prefers standard NDA + SOW before any data access.

Suggested next steps:
1) Schedule the evaluation kickoff / tech deep dive (we recommend a 60–75 minute technical session + one follow-up working session).
2) Share a short prompt set and a small sample dataset (anonymized) ahead of the technical deep dive.
3) Confirm attendees from your side (security, ops, and product owner).

Proposed evaluation window: two weeks, target start week of Jul 25 — Jul 31. If that works we can:
- Kick off with a technical deep dive on day 1 (architecture, data access, success criteria),
- Run the prompt/eval pack during week 1, and
- Do a wrap / findings review during week 2.

Can you confirm:
- Which date/time windows Jul 25–31 look best for the kickoff?
- Who should be on the tech deep dive from your side (names + roles)?
- Samir, if you're the ops contact, any constraints for S3 access / IP allowlisting we should know about?

I've copied Marissa (eng-led trial ops) and Grace (solutions engineer) who will run the evaluation. I'll attach a draft trial charter and a seed prompt set once we pick a slot.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a date.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Chen <laura@medlytics.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@medlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medlytics discovery recap + proposed trial window

Thanks everyone — I'll take point for the technical deep dive and the trial ops checklist. A few action items from my side before we lock the calendar: 

Pre-kickoff homework (ask of Medlytics):
- Share a 1000–2000 row sample (anonymized) of the notes you want normalized (CSV or NDJSON).
- Confirm an allowlist IP / CIDR for our test runner (or specify that you prefer S3 presigned uploads).
- Share a short list (3–5) of representative prompts you use today — we'll map these to the seed prompt set.

Success criteria we will measure during the trial (examples we will instrument):
- Prompt coverage: % of prompts that return non-empty extractions per prompt set (>95% target)
- Precision/recall on clinical entity extraction compared to your gold labels (recall >=90% target)
- End-to-end UI latency P50 <120ms for single requests in the trial deployment
- Resource profile: tokens-per-second throughput and per-token cost estimate for your workload

I'll also prep a one-page tech checklist and share it to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-medlytics-eval

Once Laura confirms a slot from the three proposed, I'll send a calendar invite and include dial-in + a short runbook for data delivery. If procurement needs the SOW earlier, Marissa, suggest we push the draft SOW (attached) to procurement@medlytics.com.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
